capabilities: edit callouts visually and convert them to GitHub-compatible alerts
convert Markdown tables to HTML and edit them with merge, alignment, and caption controls
render newer Mermaid diagram types in patch-mermaid blocks
add cover images, videos, and Lucide or Simple Icons to notes and folders
format math blocks, adjust line width, and export PDFs with heading bookmarks and links
disambiguation: Not a bug-fix collection; it is a bundle of optional editor and appearance enhancements, each toggled in settings.
extras: Ships in Community and Full builds with the same plugin ID; the Full build loads remote Mermaid and ELK versions from jsDelivr without an integrity check and with full access to Obsidian, and the README warns to use Loose Mermaid security level only with trusted diagrams.
intentEvidence: Use newer Mermaid diagram types and syntax without waiting for Obsidian to update its renderer.
problem: Obsidian lacks a visual editor for callouts and HTML tables, ships an older Mermaid renderer, and offers no built-in cover images, file icons, math formatting, or PDF heading bookmarks.

relations.evidence: Upgrading from Obsidian Patch? Follow the migration instructions before installing Patches
Patch Icons follows Iconize by Florian Woelki (MIT)
Line Width follows the ideas of Editor Width Slider by MugishoMp (MIT)

summary: Toolkit of focused UI and editor enhancements: callout and table editors, newer Mermaid diagrams, note covers, icons, math formatting, and PDF bookmarks.
